rationale: Existing teachers solve nonmodal cases reliably, while random students remain below length priors. Test relation specificity from existing competent recoils specialists, with six fresh paired support/U/training repeats conditional on three frozen source/target pairs. Pretrained starts change the study population and are not equivalent to the previous random-student assay.
input_and_label_budget: 192 fresh true training and64 validation labels per repeat,16384 fresh unlabeled inputs without oracle labels; same64 forward rows, homogeneous length, order, RNG, optimizer and40000 updates in each condition. Teacher-output supervision is extra information and reported separately from oracle label budget. Ordinary U rows have zero training loss.
geometry_and_mismatch: ONE_END before task prompt. Biased linear CKA loss on the same eligible combined64 rows. Correct inverse teacher vs fixed derangement within(length, training answer) on labeled rows and(length, teacher argmax) on U rows. Singleton masks identical in all geometry conditions. Both distillation geometry arms receive correct teacher logits.
selection: Primary fixed40000 update endpoint; all1200/5000/10000/20000 endpoints reported as training-dose sensitivity, never select by test.64 validation labels are monitoring only; no learning rate/weight/checkpoint selection within this registered assay. Partial deadline runs are flagged and no unequal-update primary comparison.
diagnostic_confirmation: First repeat the previous36 fixed1200 predictions on a new5120-row confirmation set; length modes fixed from previous training/U before generation. No new outcomes may change the main assay settings. All paired differences and modal/nonmodal weighted decomposition reported.
data_separation: Full eight-state orbits mutually disjoint across confirmation, final test, fresh supports and U pools; exclude all original16M parent inputs and catalogued prior local input archives. True U answers neither stored nor computed for training or matching.
scope: Known inverse relation supplied as an intervention. Tests functional benefit and relation-specific geometry from competent pretrained targets; does not establish spontaneous relation discovery or output-independent mechanism. Three source/target pairs and one original pretraining world limit population inference. Preserve all prior study artifacts. Stop training before final deadline to leave an hour for independent checks.
